name: assembly_report
description: The NCBI assembly report for this genome, as fetched by genomepy and stored verbatim. Its table gives every sequence's name in each naming scheme side by side - the assigned molecule (1, X, MT), the GenBank and RefSeq accessions, and the UCSC-style name (chr1, chrX, chrM) - with its length. That makes it the vault's chromosome alias table: the thing to consult before pairing this genome with any file that names contigs differently, such as a dbSNP VCF, which uses RefSeq accessions, or a UCSC-named blacklist. A passthrough. Present only for assemblies that have an accession; genomepy cannot fetch a report for one that does not.
